registre.intro: Every money movement is an entry. An entry is never changed or deleted: a mistake is corrected by an offsetting entry. Each entry is chained to the previous one by a fingerprint (hash).
registre.nouvelleMaquette: Mock-up: entry will be available with the database.

poids.intro: The COVIDEBA compares the criteria in pairs. The AHP method derives the weight of each criterion, then the weight of each task, which the solver then uses.
poids.criteresAide: Rename, add or delete criteria (from 2 to 10). The final names will be chosen by the COVIDEBA.
poids.comparaisonsAide: For each pair, move the slider towards the criterion that matters more. In the middle, both matter equally.
poids.coherent: The comparisons are consistent (CR less than or equal to 0.1).
poids.incoherent: The comparisons contradict each other (CR above 0.1): review them before using the weights.
poids.deuxCriteres: With two criteria, the comparisons are always consistent.
poids.notesAide: Give each task a score from 0 to 10 on each criterion. The task weight is the sum of its scores multiplied by the criteria weights.
poids.enregistrer: Use these weights in the plan
poids.enregistre: Weights saved. On the "Investment plan" page, click "Apply the AHP weights".
poids.bloque: Fix the comparisons first: the CR is above 0.1.
poids.erreurStockage: The weights could not be saved in this browser (local storage unavailable).
